summoning_condition.en: You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by sending 1 face-up Spell Card from your field to the Graveyard.

effect.en: This card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can Special Summon 1 face-up Monster Card from either player's Spell & Trap Zone to your field in face-up Defense Position.
